composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Yuji Itadori in a modest red hoodie over a dark shirt, holding an unmarked paper cup at chest height with both hands. Preserve his short pink hair, youthful rounded face, and natural teenage proportions. He looks toward the viewer with a small open smile and relaxed shoulders. Use opaque gouache with broad warm apricot and muted coral planes, keeping brush character at the clothing edges while the face stays clearly drawn. The cup is secondary and sits low enough that neither hand crosses the face. Let the centered head and shoulders occupy most of the square. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
